sources.title: Attention Is All You Need
sources.scope: 查證具名案例與原理背景。課內數值、故障資料與判準為原創教學假設；請勿當作廠商規格或操作程序。
sources.scopeEn: Establish named case and principle context. Numbers, fault data, and criteria are original teaching assumptions, not manufacturer specifications or operating procedures.

related.title: BERT：遮罩語言目標與資料洩漏
related.titleEn: BERT: masked-language targets and leakage checks
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付QKV形狀、逐頭尺度及單列注意力驗證。；分數2與1吻合，矩陣乘法shape成立，遮罩及機率和測試通過。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver QKV shapes, headwise scaling and single-row attention checks.; Scores2 and1 match, matrix shapes agree and mask/sum tests pass.
related.difference: 列input IDs、有效遮罩、被選目標及原始labels四欄；把替換策略與選取機率分開。；期望30與40正確，非目標labels擾動不影響loss且padding無貢獻。
related.differenceEn: List input IDs, valid masks, target selection and original labels; separate replacement policy from selection probability.; Expectations30 and40 match; nontarget labels and padding do not affect loss.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 分數s=q·k/√dk；單一分數不是機率，需與其他有效key一起softmax。；教學q·k=8,dk=16；保持內積8改dk64作尺度對照。；s=8/√16=2；dk64時s=1。
若每個有效token以機率p選為預測目標，期望目標數E=Np；實際樣本數受抽樣策略影響。；教學有效token200，p=.15；改p=.2，padding不計入。；E=200×.15=30；p.2時40。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Score s=q·k/√dk; a score is not a probability until softmax across valid keys.; Teaching dot product8,dk16; hold dot product8 while changing dk64.; s=8/√16=2; dk64 gives s=1.
With target-selection probability p, expected targets E=Np; realized counts depend on sampling policy.; Teaching200 valid tokens,p=.15 then.2; exclude padding.; E=200×.15=30; p.2 gives40.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: LSTM：記憶單元與門控寫入
related.titleEn: LSTM: memory cells and gated writes
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付QKV形狀、逐頭尺度及單列注意力驗證。；分數2與1吻合，矩陣乘法shape成立，遮罩及機率和測試通過。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver QKV shapes, headwise scaling and single-row attention checks.; Scores2 and1 match, matrix shapes agree and mask/sum tests pass.
related.difference: 畫記憶直通、候選乘輸入門及輸出門三路；明列c與h不同。；2.2及2.4正確，門0保留c，序列邊界與狀態介面無混淆。
related.differenceEn: Draw memory passthrough, gated candidate and output gate; distinguish c from h.; Results2.2/2.4 match, gate0 retains c and state/boundary contracts are clear.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 分數s=q·k/√dk；單一分數不是機率，需與其他有效key一起softmax。；教學q·k=8,dk=16；保持內積8改dk64作尺度對照。；s=8/√16=2；dk64時s=1。
簡化無忘記的單元c新=c舊+i g；記憶旁路局部導數1，門值的其他依賴另算。；教學c舊=2、i=.25、候選g=.8，改i=.5。；c新=2+.25×.8=2.2；改門值.5得2.4。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Score s=q·k/√dk; a score is not a probability until softmax across valid keys.; Teaching dot product8,dk16; hold dot product8 while changing dk64.; s=8/√16=2; dk64 gives s=1.

A simplified no-forgetting cell uses c_new=c_old+i g; its memory-path partial derivative is1, excluding other gate dependencies.; Teaching c_old2,input gate.25,candidate.8, then gate.5.; c_new=2+.25×.8=2.2; gate.5 gives2.4.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
